title: How To Fix Instagram Unlike Problem, Not Showing Like Bug Error 2026 Solved
description:
Check out here for How To Fix Instagram Unlike Problem, Not Showing Like Bug Error 2026 Solved.

In today’s video, I’m going to show you how you can fix the "unlike" problem on Instagram. If you're experiencing this issue where your likes are not registering or suddenly disappearing, just follow the steps I’m about to show you.

As you can see, I’m currently on Instagram, and this is how the homepage looks. At the bottom, you’ll find all the main sections: Home, Search, Reels, and your Profile.

Now, let’s talk about the issue. This problem usually occurs when you like a post, but then suddenly it appears as unliked, without you taking any action. There are several possible reasons behind this:

Step 1: Check Your Internet Connection
One common cause is a poor or unstable internet connection.
Make sure you're connected to a strong and reliable network. If your internet is weak, Instagram may not register your actions properly, such as liking or unliking posts.

Step 2: Update the Instagram App
If your internet is working fine and the problem still occurs, the next step is to update the Instagram app.

Exit Instagram.

Open the Google Play Store (for Android) or App Store (for iPhone).

Tap on the search bar, type Instagram, and open the app page.

If you see an Update button instead of "Open," that means your app is not up to date.

Tap Update and wait for it to finish installing.

Once the update is complete, tap Open to return to Instagram.

After updating, check if the "unlike" issue is resolved. In most cases, simply updating the app or refreshing your internet connection will fix the problem.

That’s it for today’s video!
If this helped you, don’t forget to like and subscribe.
Thanks for watching, and see you in the next one!
